approved: Ozone Protection and Synthetic Greenhouse Gas (Import Levy) Amendment Bill 2022
Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is part of a package that updates how the Commonwealth recovers its costs for managing ozone-depleting substances and synthetic greenhouse gases.
It would remove the cap on the levy rate and end the levy on importing ozone-depleting substance equipment.
The package would also update the main Act to streamline how Australia meets its international environmental obligations.
Removes the cap on the rate at which levies can be set.
Removes the levy on importing ozone-depleting substance equipment.
Makes minor changes to the cost recovery model under the Import Levy Act.
Importers of ozone-depleting substances and equipment are affected by the bill.
Ozone Protection and Synthetic Greenhouse Gas (Import Levy) Amendment Act 2022
